A great find
Oct 2025 • Couples
We were on the way down to the river. Check online before for some good restaurants in the area and found this place.
Even though busy for lunch, we got a table right away. Mostly locals and business people in here. A good sign.

They have a big menu with all the vietnamese classics and then some. A good selection of beer as well.

Ordered fried softshell crab, crab spring roll, Banh Xeo (rice flour pancakes), shrimp with veggies and steamed spring rolls.
The portions were really good sized, the dishes tasty and freshly prepared. Softshell crab was a highlight. Also the Banh Xeo were delicous, and there were plenty of them. Really generous portion.

Had a couple of ice cold beers with that. Went well together. Staff was very friendly and attentive.

Value is great as well, it's really fair priced and definitely aims to locals. So the meals are great and authentic and affordable. Really a great find. Highly enjoyed our lunch here.
